purpose: All published articles carrying a testing claim in ANY reader/SEO frontmatter text field (expanded scope per owner 2026-10-05 item 2), ranked for remediation batching.
sort_rule: gsc_impressions DESC (null last) -> inbound_internal_links DESC -> affected_field_count DESC -> slug ASC

column_definitions.gsc_impressions: aggregated from docs/audit-worklist-v2.json gsc_top_pages (resolves_to + impressions); null = that file carries no GSC row resolving to this article
column_definitions.inbound_internal_links: number of DISTINCT published articles linking to this article (task-G convention); validated against worklist values except the 2 noted mismatches
column_definitions.affected_field_count: number of scanned reader/SEO text fields carrying at least one of the 8 patterns
column_definitions.fields: field -> list of pattern names matched in that field
column_definitions.faq_qa_with_claims: FYI only — FAQ question/answer blocks are reader-facing content but OUTSIDE the granted editing scope
column_definitions.in_draft_pr_484: slug is one of the 9 articles of draft PR #484
